title: Sunset Palms-Pool, Spa & Sports Court-Scottsdale
description: Escape to Sunset Palms, your ultimate Scottsdale escape! Lounge by the sparkling pool, soak in the hot tub, or challenge friends to pickleball, basketball, or pool. Fire up the barbecue for a fun feast. Cozy up around the fire pit, whip up meals in the modern kitchen, and relax in a bright living space. Just minutes from Kierland Commons & Scottsdale Quarter, where you can browse boutiques, savor gourmet bites, sip cocktails & enjoy Scottsdale’s energy.
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, wardrobe, and dresser
Free parking garage on premises – 2 spaces
Housekeeping available from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, every day - available at extra cost
Paid standalone high chair - available upon request
Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, lap pool
review_snippets: Ac was broken when I arrived house temperature was in the high 90s hard time sleeping somewhere like that. Pool filter was full and clogged up making the pool visually hazy. Not worth the cost to stay with so many issues and not being able to be comfortable in a extremely hot house

The outside area at this house is beautiful, and definitely our favorite part of the house. The size was great and able to accommodate our large family. Some of the amenities were lacking, including no working ice makers and extreme heat in one of the bedrooms in the main house (the bedroom closest to the pool).
An excellent place to stay and enjoy. Good communication with the host, friendly staff. Thank you for hosting us.

Great place to stay but I would highly recommend that they get a new cleaning service.  There was a sandwich behind one of the bedroom doors, and ants everywhere.  They came over with a can of Raid and sprayed in the bedroom but there were still ants.
Great place. There were some minor issues, but they responded right away and were very easy to deal with. Thanks for the stay!
